details: Bitcoin has demonstrated resilience despite a surging US dollar and elevated Treasury yields. However, its realized volatility has fallen to historical lows, with a study of nearly a decade of price history suggesting that this quiet period could precede more significant price swings.
title: Bitcoin Defies Macro Headwinds, Volatility Nears Lows

details: The U.S. Treasury's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) is taking steps to withdraw two long-dormant proposals related to anti-money laundering oversight for self-hosted crypto wallets and crypto mixers.
title: FinCEN Moves to Withdraw Crypto AML Proposals

details: Piero Cipollone, an executive board member of the European Central Bank (ECB), stated that a digital euro would enhance the competitiveness of European banks against international rivals, emphasizing emerging opportunities for European payment service providers.
title: ECB Official Highlights Digital Euro for European Bank Competition

details: Nvidia is reportedly in preliminary discussions to increase its investment in or acquire Reflection AI, an open-source artificial intelligence startup. The deal could involve an "acqui-hire" strategy, potentially bypassing lengthy regulatory reviews.
title: Nvidia Explores Deeper Investment or Acquisition of Reflection AI

details: Prediction market platform Kalshi is probing three suspicious bets totaling $173 that accurately predicted President Trump's press secretary appointment before its public announcement, with payouts expected to reach $9,600. This incident follows a previous CFTC settlement concerning similar insider trading on prediction markets.
title: Kalshi Investigates Insider Trading on Trump's Press Secretary Bet

details: Following two consecutive days of substantial outflows amounting to $731 million, U.S. spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) experienced a modest $21 million inflow on October 9. While this only recovers 3% of recent losses, it may indicate a subtle shift in investor sentiment, even as Ethereum and Solana ETFs continue to face struggles.
title: Bitcoin ETFs Register Minor Inflows After $731M Outflow

details: An attack on Riyadh's international airport on Saturday resulted in 12 fatalities and over 300 injuries, marking the deadliest incident in Saudi Arabia in a decade. The Iran-backed Houthis have intensified their campaign, raising concerns about further destabilization in the Middle East and potential impacts on global energy markets.
title: Houthi Strike on Saudi Airport Kills 12, Escalates Regional Conflict
